sloka: तरस्विनौ धारयता मृगस्य सत्त्वेन रूपं मनुजेन्द्रपुत्रौ ।नूनं विशस्तौ मम कारणात् तौ सिंहर्षभौ द्वाविव वैद्यतेन ।। ५.२८.९।।।।
transliteration: tarasvinau dhārayatā mṛgasya sattvena rūpaṁ manujendraputrau ।nūnaṁ viśastau mama kāraṇāt tau siṁharṣabhau dvāviva vaidyatena ।। 5.28.9।।।।

translations.english: "Just like two mighty lions are killed by a bolt of lightning, the two princes must have been killed by a creature in the guise of a deer on my account.
